newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips dragged lower by weak technology shares.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips dragged lower by weak technology shares.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed lower Monday as a sharp drop in technology shares cut short the market's rally propelled by news of Boeing Co. and McDonnell Douglas Corp.'s mega merger.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended down 36.52 points at 6,268.35 after a drop of more than 50 points activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on programme trading. In the broader market, declining issues beat advances 2-1 on active volume of 452 million shares on the NYSE.
